items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: and I had the pleasure of going through that bus, and he showed it to me one time.

ctx.x: Well, he was a smart guy, man. He bought a bus for his band. Well, he got so many royalties, so much money from the tunes that he had written, of course, he had a lot of hits, and, man, he bought a bus that was quite expensive, and I had the pleasure of going through that bus, and he showed it to me one time. And he had his little office in the bus, had it made up special, and this particular bus that he had, they had their own beds and everything in it. It was really specially equipped. Not like the Newark…
Well, that's what I was wondering, if --
